articles.title: Equestrian Complex Blends Horse Care and Contemplation in Jalisco
articles.summary: Rancho del Abuelo is an equestrian complex in Jalisco, Mexico, designed to shelter horses while providing spaces for rest and gathering. The project creates varied ways of living and engaging with the landscape. Mendiola Arregui designed the facility on Guadalajara's outskirts.

articles.title: Residence Maximizes Indoor-Outdoor Connection on Flat Brazilian Terrain
articles.summary: Apiacás Arquitetos designed a 250 m² residence in Vinhedo, Brazil, positioned to maximize interaction between indoor and outdoor areas. The layout follows a tested residential logic suited to the flat, generous plot. It emphasizes connection with external spaces.

articles.title: Beige Monolith House Emerges from Mexican Desert Mist
articles.summary: Casa Neblina sits among orchards and palm groves in El Pescadero, Mexico, appearing as a beige monolith emerging from coastal mist. Red Arquitectos designed the desert home to blend with the landscape. The materiality echoes the surrounding natural environment.

articles.title: Historic Monastery Transformed into Five-Star Hotel in Portugal
articles.summary: MiMool Arquitectura rehabilitated the former Monastery of Santa Maria de Arouca into a five-star hotel in Portugal. The project, part of the REVIVE program, transforms the National Monument beyond simple functional adaptation. It preserves heritage while adding contemporary hospitality functions.

articles.title: Narrow Lot Home Balances Density, Light, and Privacy
articles.summary: SUPRBLK Studio's Turquoise House fits a family home, architecture studio, and apartment on a narrow Halifax lot. Two gabled volumes and courtyards create density without sacrificing light, privacy, or outdoor connection. The design maximizes livability on a constrained urban site.

articles.title: AEME Building / Paz Arquitectura
articles.summary: AEME is a building located in Guatemala City . It has an open floor plan on the first floor dedicated to commercial use and restaurants, a second floor that combines commerce and offices, and three floors exclusively dedicated to offices. The first floor is connected to the street through a double-height entrance with the purpose of emphasizing the opening towards a friendly urban use, with an aim to allow the first floor to be interpreted as an extension of the public space.

articles.summary: Earlier we looked at the work of Dream Domes , a UK-based event structure company. They've worked out a way to erect large event tents with no central support. In the UK is another company called Unidome that also builds circular-footprint event structures, albeit smaller, and with transparent walls. Rather than being competitors, the two companies are collaborating. articles.title: Industrial Design Student Work: A Hard Drive that Visually Indicates How Full It Is
articles.summary: This morphing hard drive enclosure is by Antonin Odin , done as an Industrial Design student at France's ENSCI . People increasingly want more visibility over their data, more taste in the objects they live with, and more function from both. ZO is a 12 TB personal server that gives storage a body. Empty, it's a plain aluminium tube. As it fills up, its fins slide out one by one, one millimetre for every 400 GB. Switched off, it keeps its shape: it shows what it holds. articles.title: The Youth: Resin-Shelled Upcycled Chairs
articles.summary: Younghyun Lee restores old chairs by applying a resin shell. The process preserves the original scars and aging of the wood.

articles.title: Remote-Controlled Adjustable Shade Desert Pavilion
articles.summary: A conceptual pavilion designed for desert environments. It allows users to adjust the shade remotely to follow the sun's movement.

articles.title: Foster + Partners Unveils New Milan Stadium Design
articles.summary: Foster + Partners and Manica Architecture have revealed their design for the Generali Stadium in Milan, intended as the replacement for the iconic San Siro stadium. The new venue represents a major architectural undertaking in sports design.

articles.title: Dubai Design Week Returns for 12th Edition
articles.summary: Dubai Design Week is hosting its 12th edition, celebrating bold Middle Eastern design through exhibitions and installations across Dubai Design District. The event spotlights geometric forms and works by prominent regional architects.

articles.title: Ten Office Products Elevating Workplace Interiors
articles.summary: Dezeen showcases ten innovative office products, including desks with integrated outlets, modular seating, and ergonomic chairs. These designs aim to streamline workspaces without sacrificing aesthetics.

articles.title: Metabolist Influence Defines Montreal Bistro Design
articles.summary: Atelier Zébulon Perron has designed Bistrot à Franky in Montreal with a monochrome palette inspired by Japanese Metabolism. The eatery blends minimalist aesthetics with structural references to the Metabolist movement.

articles.title: Olaver Completes Lantern-Like Glass-Block Studio in Melbourne
articles.summary: Australian firm Olaver has built a two-storey glass-block studio in Melbourne, featuring a lantern-like facade. The structure combines recycled materials with a minimalist concrete frame.

articles.title: Tschabalala Appoints Bold Blue Sculpture in Trafalgar Square
articles.summary: Artist Tschabalala Self's new sculpture 'Lady in Blue' is installed in Trafalgar Square, sparking discourse on contemporary public monuments. The piece is described as a fitting tribute to the current era.

articles.title: Apple Introduces First Touchscreen MacBook Pro
articles.summary: Apple has launched its first touchscreen MacBook Pro, featuring what it calls the world’s best laptop display. The release marks a significant shift in the company's approach to laptop interface design.
